description: Shared file tail vectors (C# FileTailSourceTests, Rust bower-source-file tests). Inputs are hand-written; expectations come from the C# specification (BOWER_FILE_TAIL_VECTOR_OUTPUT regenerates them) and are reviewed by hand. Sequences with "fileIds" compare device and inode numbers: real ones in Rust (Unix), modelled by the C# harness.
